source.title: EzDisenchant 1.1.7, release Nov 15 2026 — CSV/TXT disenchant history export
source.author: xBambyQT

notes: New original-capture acquisition lane: a released Retail 12.1.5 addon claims a bounded 500-record per-character disenchant history and CSV/TXT export, unlike summary-only ProspectMate. This is product feature evidence, NOT a user-provided study or proof its CSV includes output IDs, source itemLink/bonus, collected material quantities, zero outcomes, completed-cast timing, source patch, skill, or specialization. Six focused name searches across CurseForge, GitHub, and Reddit plus release notes did not reveal a real exported CSV/row schema or measured Midnight cohort. 500 is storage cap, NEVER a denominator. Do not double-count author exports if independently submitted elsewhere. Novel acquisition candidate, not an exhausted material-yield source.
lookingFor: Original verifiable 2026 Retail 12.1.5 EzDisenchant CSV/TXT with input itemLink (incl. bonus+actual ilvl), per-cast measured material output itemIDs/quantities, true complete casts, zero outcome/skill/spec/build for item 272246 or other Midnight gear
